scope: Final candidate v2; exactly one references pair. Previous candidate is supporting design history only, not additional v2 validation samples.
required: Actual final serialized payload differs only in the exact two removed refresh tutorial sentences and separately attributed environment paths; every other original read.description sentence, all tool schemas and execution sources remain unchanged.
Both actual references episodes must have valid admission, known model usage, passing business output and passing critical complete same-owner resource contracts.

Inspect the actual selection, adoption, reads, batching and recovery traces. A candidate-specific observed wrong skill/owner, broken content/adoption boundary, repeated unnecessary consumption or user intervention blocks adoption.
limits: Keep all formal unknown outcomes and insufficient-evidence statistics; metadata-only discovery must be independently proven and arbitrary shell remains opaque.

A noncritical absence-proof unknown is not promoted to pass. A release decision may use the passing positive business/resource contracts and inspected traces, but may not claim full formal success or population-level noninferiority.

Payload reduction is deterministic; first-request provider token deltas and whole-episode tokens/time are separate observations. Do not claim whole-task efficiency improvement unless the actual evidence supports it.
No v1/v2 pooling and no historical model reruns. The standing grant remains unbounded.
